newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Strategic to place Tricom shares.
newsitem.headline: China Strategic to place Tricom shares.

text.p: China Strategic Holdings Ltd and parties acting in concert with it announced on Wednesday the company would place shares in subsidiary Tricom Holdings Ltd at the end of the week.
China Strategic and its wholly-owned subsidiary have obtained control of 96 percent of the share capital of subsidiary Tricom Holdings Ltd.

In a statement, the parties announced they intend to place out 21.72 percent of the issued shares of Tricom at HK$1.25 per share. This represents a premium of 4.17 percent from the closing price of HK$1.20 on November 4.
Following the placing, which is expected to take place two business days after resumption of trading in the shares, the total number of shares to be held by the public will be 25.55 percent.
China Strategic said the company and two parties acting in concert with it had received valid acceptances for a total of 41.39 million shares, or 18.1 percent of the issued share capital of Tricom.
These acceptances, together with shares the parties already control, had given the group an interest of 219.712 million shares, representing 96.0 percent of the issued capital.
A total of 8.76 million shares, or 4.0 percent, remained in public hands.
Trading in Tricom shares will resume on Wednesday, November 20.
